page.overview:
What is Green Asteroid?

The Green Asteroid was a ship, and a trader in the Polesotechnic League. Whiplash had arranged for the Zeltron Dejah Duare to take the ship home to Zeltros. Dejah, however, opted to stay on Coruscant.
